data.value: The folder {0} is write-protected, so Raffica cannot replace itself there. Nothing was changed. Get the new version from the download page.

data.name: UpdateFailureNotStarted
data.value: The new version is installed, but it could not be started. It starts the next time you open Raffica.

data.name: UpdateFailureVersionMismatch
data.value: The installer finished, but the installed program is not the new version yet. Files may have been replaced. Try again, or restart your computer and open Raffica.

data.name: UpdateFailureHelperInstallFailed
data.value: The installer did not finish, or the permission prompt was declined. Files may have been replaced. Try again, or get the new version from the download page.

data.name: CrashMessage
data.value: Save your work under a new name and restart Raffica PDF. Details are in crash.log.
